blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Inherently Safe... requires no human intervention' framing addresses reactor physics safety but says nothing about who trains base personnel to operate, monitor, or respond to the microreactor once installed.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Even a passively-safe reactor still needs base engineers or a sustainment contract for monitoring, physical security of special nuclear material, and NRC/DoD compliance reporting — none of this is addressed.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team and roadmap are focused on reactor physics and licensing at this concept stage; operations/sustainment planning naturally comes later.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Designed with passive safety systems that require no human intervention or external power.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Roadmap only references 'regulatory pre-application engagement with the NRC,' with no mention of the separate DoD-side approval chain (installation authority, Army/AF nuclear safety review) needed to place a reactor on a military base.
blind_spots.operator_reality: An NRC license alone doesn't authorize placement on a DoD installation — that's a second, DoD-specific approval process the roadmap never names.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: NRC licensing is the more familiar regulatory hurdle for a nuclear-hardware team; DoD-specific site authorization processes are less visible externally at this stage.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 2026–2027 Engineering & Testing: Detailed engineering, component testing, regulatory pre-application engagement with the NRC.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Company markets identically to 'Defense & Military,' 'Remote & Off-Grid,' 'Industrial Off-Grid,' and 'Critical Infrastructure' with no differentiated advocacy-chain story for the military market specifically — no named installation, pilot program, or DoD champion.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Operators loving the pitch is not adoption — without a named installation-level sponsor, defense is one of four parallel markets pitched with the same paragraph, with no evidence of an actual DoD relationship.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Pre-prototype company is still casting a wide net across markets to build early partnerships and interest.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Providing 100% of critical loads with reliable, secure, carbon-free power. Designed for defense installations, remote operations, and infrastructure that cannot afford downtime.

opener_hook: StarCube's own roadmap doesn't reach a prototype until 2028-2029 — years before its stated 'defense installations' deployment target, with no DoD-specific approval chain named alongside the NRC licensing path.
what_they_do: Pre-prototype developer of factory-built, transportable nuclear microreactors targeting defense installations and off-grid/critical infrastructure; first prototype not planned until 2028-2029.
